sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C12975-K2 held by customer C12975 (internal case AC-HHF-004, opened 2017-01-26). Between 2017-01-05 and 2017-01-26 the card was used for 6 transaction(s) totalling $23.99: on 2017-01-05 $3.51 online in billing region 191.0; on 2017-01-07 $5.18 online in billing region 191.0; on 2017-01-14 $2.66 online in billing region 191.0; on 2017-01-18 $4.75 online in billing region 191.0; on 2017-01-22 $4.99 online in billing region 191.0; on 2017-01-26 $2.90 online in billing region 337.0. The activity matches a coordinated undocumented wave across 17 cards sharing the signature (Multi-day sub-$6 online ProductCD='C' micro-charge skimming wave across 18 cards). The other connected cards in this wave are C00129-K1, C00348-K1, C01326-K2, C03427-K2, C03488-K1, C03611-K2, C04274-K1, C04528-K1, C05083-K1, C05263-K2, C06198-K1, C09471-K2, C10035-K2, C10654-K1, C11332-K1, C13290-K1. The cardholder reported that they did not make the purchase and still hold the card. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $58.00). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, 16 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
